resources.string: Real-time accessible speech-to-text captions with reader-paced display.
Microphone audio is processed in real-time on your device only. No audio is stored, uploaded, or transmitted to any external server.
Caption text is broadcast locally over your Wi-Fi network (port 8765) to browsers you open on the same network. No data leaves your local network or is sent to the internet.
Heard requires no user account and collects no personal information. There is no advertising, analytics, or third-party data sharing of any kind.
Microphone — required to capture speech for captions.\nNotification — to show a persistent status notification while captions are running (can be denied; captions still work).
Push to talk: tap to start listening
Push to talk: tap to stop listening
